prompt.body:
@projmgrauth
Set repo: elmtui.lisp

# ElmTUI coverage badge and full application qualification

Canonical project: elmtui-clpm
Exact intended root: /home/user/code/lisp/elmtui.lisp
Task purpose: 07-qualification, enhancement wave 20261014. The dispatcher binds the exact task ID; recover it from the governed handoff, never manufacture one.

Own scripts/coverage.lisp, scripts/run-coverage-warning-clean.sh, root .github/workflows/ci.yml, README.org, test/coverage gate additions, shared elmtui-tests.asd registration only by coordinated claim, and narrowly scoped scripts/test-terminal-apps.py and tests/e2e validation. Do not edit src/ui/dsl*, src/ui/defcomponent.lisp, src/app/application.lisp, src/app/tea-core.lisp, library code or consumer gitlinks. Preserve unrelated deletion docs/release-history-purge.md. Coordinate shared manifest writes after the DSL/macro lanes stabilize; test-only qualification can proceed independently.
Current root coverage script parses HTML, ignores zero-covered files when calculating an unweighted average and has no prominent measured-code-coverage badge. Replace misleading aggregate claims with trustworthy owned-source coverage and a fail-closed ratchet; distinguish README docstring coverage from code coverage. Validate instrumentation boundaries and actual root test result propagation. Use source inventory from the supported primary system; optional systems require separately named reports, not silent denominator exclusions.
Run fresh full framework and optional supported suites, standalone library tests, warning-clean, facade identity, public-docstring and generated-reference freshness gates. Execute complete terminal applications with real PTY/private tmux and available native urxvt in an isolated display. Assert input, focus/keymap actions, scroll/bottom-row clipping, resize from small to large and back, cursor/termios/surrounding-screen restoration on quit and exceptional unwind, bounded worker shutdown and repeat runs. Recheck October 8 leads (minimal quit, focus/keymap startup, Game of Life keys, scroll-panel rendering, Wi-Fi repeated Enter while busy) against current source; do not re-fix already closed defects. Wi-Fi must use fake nmcli, including slow-command double-Enter, and must never alter host networking. Record absent urxvt/display capability as missing live proof. If a runtime defect lies outside owned test/CI paths, produce its failing regression and one narrowly scoped repair successor; do not silently cross another worker's claim.
Require matrix rows tying DSL/macros/library consumer contracts to full-app behavior, and retain exact revisions so concurrent changes do not contaminate results. Before final qualification rerun impacted integration at the accepted final revisions. Provide docs/operator-qualification-20261014.md separating local compile/unit/generative/PT Y/tmux/urxvt, hosted CI, badge data availability and mandatory independent-review status. Hosted publication remains pending unless independently verified.

You are the senior Common Lisp maintainer responsible for delivering implementation, meaningful regression tests, and reviewable evidence. The user authorizes local fixes and refinements in the stated scope. Work autonomously through investigation, implementation, validation, required independent review, and evidence-backed continuation. Do not stop at suggestions or an audit report.

Operating contract:
- Resolve the exact Git root, HEAD, branch, local instructions, project identity, dirty files, active path claims, existing task/checkpoint results, and effective bridge.yml before writing. Task state running alone is not liveness. Reuse completed work and avoid competing with active ownership. Preserve unrelated dirty state; never reset, clean, delete user work, or rewrite history. Do not push, tag, release, or publish externally under this task.
- Activate authenticated project filesystem tools; establish a fresh agent session and retain its binding where required. Adopt or admit and bind the exact canonical task/packet, begin it, and obey transactional mutations, leases, stale-write checks, and independent review. Missing ordinary packet metadata is routine setup, not a reason to refuse work. Respect explicit nonrecoverable admission or ownership denials. A browser response is not filesystem implementation.
- Inspect contracts and establish a fresh baseline before editing. Reproduce concrete gaps with failing tests, then make the smallest coherent repair. Use balanced expression edits for Lisp/ASDF and verify cold reader/compiler/load behavior. Prefer existing CLOS protocols and standard CL idioms over hidden globals, eval, string-generated code, or needless new layers. Preserve public compatibility or provide an explicit tested migration.
- Tests must detect observable incorrect behavior, including boundaries and failures. Do not increase assertion counts by duplicating checks, substitute mocks for claimed live behavior, suppress warnings broadly, weaken thresholds, exclude hard-to-test owned source, or call a skipped test passed. Run focused checks first, then the affected full suites once after final edits; retain exact commands, revisions, pass/fail/skip counts, logs and artifacts.
- Record a gap ledger: source/contract, reproduction, severity, repair, regression evidence, and remaining work. Historical TODOs and old reports are leads, not current proof. Finish each concrete phase with a durable checkpoint and the configured typed phase result containing changed paths, baseline/final evidence, residual blockers and review references. Submit required independent review, address its findings, and do not self-approve.

Autonomous continuation:
Continue useful in-scope work within the current phase. Before context exhaustion, checkpoint exact progress, claims, transaction state, commands, failures, and the next executable action. After the configured review gate, if evidence shows acceptance remains unmet, admit one idempotent canonical successor carrying the same bounded scope, predecessor/result references, exact residual acceptance and dependency prerequisites; queue and dispatch through the installed native OCP surface when allowed. If promotion requires an operator gate, leave that exact successor ready with the actual gate reason. Never use retired prolonged/next.md or chain schedulers, recursively resend yourself, create parallel duplicate successors, invent authority, or perform endless audit-only rounds. No-progress continuation must name a concrete blocker and what changes it. Stop only at reviewed acceptance or an evidenced external/ownership blocker.

Report implementation, local tests, live terminal tests, hosted CI, badge availability, and review as separate evidence layers. Leave Org-roam STATUS/TODO projection with AGENTIC conventions through the supported workflow; avoid duplicating an automatic phase-result projection.

Coverage acceptance:
Provide a prominent README badge backed by reproducible measurements and a linked report, with a documented metric (SB-COVER executable lines or expressions, explicitly distinguished), covered/total counts, per-file breakdown, source revision and reproducible command. Instrument all owned runtime source before forced compilation, disable instrumentation for tests/dependencies, clear stale data, and ensure unexecuted source contributes to the denominator. Never average per-file percentages or use docstring/assertion counts as code coverage. Fail closed on test failure, missing/empty/malformed reports, denominator drift, unsupported compiler capability, and threshold regression. Add negative-path tests for the gate. Reuse a correct existing workflow; repair defects rather than installing competing infrastructure. Ratchet from an honestly measured baseline and prioritize meaningful coverage of highest-risk gaps; retain any existing stronger gate. CI uploads reports even on failure, but a configured publication job may publish badge data only following successful trusted default-branch verification with minimum scoped permissions. Do not execute an external publish/push now: identify hosted availability as pending unless independently observed. Verify README endpoint matches the repository/branch/artifact contract. Document exclusions and portability boundaries precisely.
prompt.title: ElmTUI coverage badge and full application qualification
